description: Ghidra extension and stdio MCP bridge that serve live Ghidra analysis (plus x64dbg debugging) to AI agent harnesses.
notes: Ghidra loads exactly one extension build per Ghidra version line, so this package ships both: $dir\ghidra11.4.3\Ghydra for Ghidra 11.4.3 and $dir\ghidra12.2\Ghydra for Ghidra 12.2.
Install the matching build: copy <variant>\Ghydra into <Ghidra>\Extensions\Ghidra\Ghydra, or let bin/Install-GhydraMCP.ps1 do it (it matches the installed Ghidra version and refuses a mismatch).
Installing is not enabling: open a CodeBrowser, then File > Configure > Developer and tick Ghydra. The first instance binds port 8192.
The stdio MCP bridge is $dir\bridge_mcp_hydra.py and runs with uv: uv run --script $dir\bridge_mcp_hydra.py.

Harness wiring (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, VS Code, Zed, opencode, Continue): bin/Install-GhydraMCP.ps1 -DryRun first; it merges one 'ghydra' server entry and leaves other servers untouched.
post_install: foreach ($variant in 'ghidra11.4.3','ghidra12.2') { $jar = Join-Path $dir "$variant/Ghydra/lib/Ghydra.jar"; if (-not (Test-Path $jar)) { warn "GhydraMCP: the $variant payload is missing its Ghydra.jar" } }
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'bridge_mcp_hydra.py'))) { warn 'GhydraMCP: bridge_mcp_hydra.py did not extract' }
if ($installer) { info "Harness setup: pwsh '$($installer.FullName)' -DryRun   (drop -DryRun to apply)" } else { info 'Harness setup: run bin/Install-GhydraMCP.ps1 from the scoop-alts checkout.' }
